newsitem.title: UK: Modest rise in cotton turnover in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Modest rise in cotton turnover in Europe.

text.p: Business rose modestly in some northern European cotton markets, industry sources said on Thursday.

Spinners showed more interest in nearby shipments in the face of a increased demand for yarn, but trade further forward was cautious. This reflected recent fluctuations in the New York futures market in response to conflicting crop reports, particularly within the U.S.
The main growths mentioned in Western European business included Central Asian and Greek, with Spanish descriptions attracting some attention.
